# Vanshaj Gugnani

> Full stack developer building fast, accessible web products for teams in
> Toronto and across Canada. React, Next.js, Node, .NET, and AI integrations.

Vanshaj Gugnani is a full stack developer with 5+ years of experience and 20+
delivered projects, including 10+ AI-powered solutions. He works end to end:
frontend architecture, backend systems, and the cloud delivery around them.

## Expertise

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, Redux,
  Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Framer Motion, Angular, accessibility
- Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS, .NET / ASP.NET, Java / Spring Boot, Go,
  PHP, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, OAuth
- Data and AI: Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, Firebase,
  Prisma, Pandas, NumPy, data pipelines, generative AI, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG
- Cloud and delivery: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Azure, GCP, Docker,
  Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

## Selected work

- [Figure Out Media](https://figureoutmedia.com): Marketing site for a Toronto
  video studio. Brand films and campaign work as a scroll-driven reel the team
  can update themselves. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, AWS.
- [Prowave](https://prowave.co): Site for an AI automation agency, explaining
  workflow, voice, and support agents to non-technical buyers. Next.js, NestJS,
  Python, LangGraph, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare.
- [Empreso](https://empreso.ca): Career platform for people moving into tech
  roles, covering resume tooling, interview prep, background checks, and
  training. Next.js, NestJS, MySQL, Redis, generative AI, Azure.
- [Konnecture](https://konnecture.vgugnani.com): Consultancy site for a business
  scaling firm, covering growth planning, automation, and investor readiness.
  Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, generative AI.
